verdict.rationale: Docs show first-class TypeScript (docs-14, docs-32) and Python (docs-25, docs-33) support, and community comments confirm Ruby and PHP SDKs exist (temporal-comm-2), indicating multi-language authoring is real. However, the evidence pack never documents a Go SDK or makes any explicit claim of feature parity across SDKs, and one community comment even flags a language gap (no JS) at the time of posting. Missing for 10: explicit Go SDK documentation, a stated cross-SDK feature-parity policy/matrix, and independent confirmation that less-common SDKs (Ruby, PHP, .NET) match the core SDKs' capabilities.
